name: handoff-note-roundtrip
description: Session 1 edits two files and exits; the note is written at the session's end and stored. Session 2 starts in the same repo and gets the [handoff] note once, at its first prompt.

sessions.name: edit two files
sessions.prompt: Add an exported function subtract(a, b) that returns a - b to src/math.js, and an exported function shout(s) that returns s.toUpperCase() + '!' to src/strings.js. Use the Edit tool for both files. Do not run anything. When both edits are done, reply with one short line.

assert.label: no note is injected into the first session
debug log: the note was written
store holds a note for the temp repo
the stored note names the work

sessions.name: next session reads the note
sessions.prompt: Without using any tools, say in one sentence what was last done in this repository, from what you already know.

assert.label: [handoff] session-start note injected exactly once
assert.matches: ^\[handoff\] This session is starting\. Here is the handoff note for this repository \({{repo}}\)

assert.label: no other [handoff] text anywhere in what reached the model
